audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 disagreed with the packet chart: Level 1 read Skill, Level 3 read Renekton, Levels 4-5 read Skill, Level 6 read Skill and First item read Renekton.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Renekton / Kled / Skill / Renekton, and the mirror flipped exactly those five rows. Level 6 is Kled's: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is up at 110-140s alongside a shield and Skaarl's second bar, while Dominus is 120s.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs, with ratings and the three contradicting full-layer whys reworded; whys[0] and whys[5] reworded so the content captions match their new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ultimate is spelled 'Chaaaaarge!' in three places, its shield is never mentioned, and Violent Tendencies — his actual burst — appears nowhere.
audit.why: Riot's kit: the ultimate is Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and it grants a SHIELD as well as the charge and ram, which is the burst window the page told the player to walk into blind. A 50-Fury Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target, so that shield is deleted rather than absorbed — the single most useful fact in this matchup. Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset granting massive attack speed for four attacks with a bigger fourth hit: the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Bear Trap on a Rope shackles first and yanks only after a short duration, so the pull has a reaction window.
audit.corrected: Name corrected and the shield stated in whys[4], spikes[2].text, wants.foe[2] and mid; the shackle-then-yank delay written into dosFull[1].d; Violent Tendencies named as the follow-up in dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is headed 'Let him remount freely' but its body is unrelated boilerplate about burning a cooldown.
audit.why: Kled restores Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies and remounts with a portion of the health back — so the dismount window closes if you let him hit anything, including minions.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the courage-by-fighting remount.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are your clearest advantage window — you have cooldown reduction in runes kicking in, your Q heal is meaningful, and Kled's power is heavily gated on landing Bear Trap on a Rope first. If he misses the grab, run the full pattern: slice in, empowered W stun, Q, dice out. The key wrinkle is Skaarl's dismount mechanic: when you burn him down to dismount threshold, Kled loses his Q grab and his mobility dash until he remounts, which is 4-5 seconds of him being almost helpless — keep dumping autos and Q on him in that window. At level 6 the math shifts — Kled's Chaaaaarge! gives him a sudden engage tool with a second health bar buffer, so do NOT walk at him with your R active thinking you will run him down. Instead, trade first to trigger Skaarl's dismount before he can launch R, then finish him while he is on foot.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are your clearest advantage window — cooldown reduction is kicking in, your Q heal is meaningful, and Kled's power is gated on landing Bear Trap on a Rope first. If he misses the grab, run the full pattern: slice in, empowered W stun, Q, dice out. The key wrinkle is Skaarl's dismount: on foot his hook is replaced by Pocket Pistol and he deals less damage to you, and he only remounts by fighting something — so deny him minions and keep dumping autos and Q. At level 6 the math shifts: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is a long-range engage that also shields him, so do NOT walk at him with your R active expecting to run him down. If he opens with it, 50-Fury Ruthless Predator destroys that shield outright — then finish him on foot.
